# orchestra_environment (Data Source)

A single environment, including its values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read one environment, including its values. The list data source
# (orchestra_environments) deliberately omits values; only this one returns them.
data "orchestra_environment" "production" {
  id = "11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555"
}

output "production_values" {
  value = data.orchestra_environment.production.values
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The environment ID.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Account the environment belongs to.
- `allow_unpublished_pipelines` (Boolean) Whether unpublished pipelines may run against this environment.
- `allowed_branches` (List of String) Branches allowed to run against this environment.
- `created_at` (String) When the environment was created.
- `default_env` (Boolean) Whether this is the default environment.
- `name` (String) Environment name.
- `updated_at` (String) When the environment was last updated.
- `values` (Attributes Map) Environment values keyed by variable name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--values))

<a id="nestedatt--values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `values`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Value type.
- `value` (String) The value, rendered as a string.
